titleZh: 公開 ↔ 私密｜廣場喇叭對隔音房
hook: overt／publicize 在廣場開喇叭，covert／confidential／closet 進隔音房——記者會與密談隔一道門。
script: 公開隊：overt／publicize／disclose／broadcast。私密隊：covert／confidential／closet／secluded／classified。口令：喇叭寫「說給大家聽」，隔音房寫「到此為止」。

members.speakLineEn: The club will publicize the blood drive on posters all across campus.
members.speakLineZh: 社團會用滿校園的海報，宣傳這次捐血活動。

members.speakLineEn: She kept the birthday gifts hidden in the hall closet until Saturday morning.
members.speakLineZh: 她把生日禮物藏在走廊壁櫥裡，直到週六早上才拿出來。

members.speakLineEn: They rented a secluded cabin where no traffic noise could reach the porch.
members.speakLineZh: 他們租了一間隱居般的小屋，門廊聽不到任何車聲。

members.speakLineEn: Only staff with clearance may open that classified folder on the secure drive.
members.speakLineZh: 只有取得許可的人員，才能開啟安全硬碟上那份機密資料夾。

members.speakLineEn: Street musicians filled the sunny plaza with soft guitar music at noon.
members.speakLineZh: 中午時，街頭樂手用輕柔吉他聲填滿陽光灑落的廣場。

members.speakLineEn: The radio host recorded the interview inside a soundproof booth downtown.
members.speakLineZh: 電台主持人在市中心一間隔音房裡錄製訪談。

members.speakLineEn: Please drop your signed permission slip into the blue folder on my desk.
members.speakLineZh: 請把簽好名的同意書放進我桌上那本藍色資料夾。

members.speakLineEn: He replaced the rusty lock on the garden gate before winter storms arrived.
members.speakLineZh: 冬季風暴來前，他先換掉花園大門上生鏽的鎖。

members.speakLineEn: A bright poster for the spring musical hung beside the cafeteria entrance.
members.speakLineZh: 春日音樂劇的鮮豔海報，掛在餐廳入口旁。

reviewHooks: closet 可作形容詞＝祕密的
pitfalls: overt 與 covert 是一對經典反義
